description:
ConvertPDF brings a PDF toolkit into ChatGPT. Attach a file and ask in plain words: compress a PDF so it fits an email limit, merge several PDFs in the order you want, split a document into parts, turn a PDF or a scan into an editable Word document or an Excel spreadsheet, convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG or iPhone HEIC photos to PDF, render pages as images, crop or resize pages, and add page numbers or a watermark.

ConvertPDF runs the work on its own servers in the European Union and returns a download link for the result, with the real before-and-after size for compression. Documents are never sent to third-party AI or conversion services and are deleted automatically within one hour. It works only on the files you attach and never asks for passwords, signatures, payment details or other personal information. Sign in once with Google or an email code; the free plan includes a daily allowance.

defaultPrompt: Compress this PDF so I can email it
Merge these PDFs into one file in the order I attached them
Turn this scanned PDF into an editable Word document
